title: Evaluation under a wider input space
statement: Let $m	ext{ and }n$ be nonnegative integers with $m\le n$, let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree on $m$ variables, and let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ variables. The circuit obtained by widening $c$ to $n$ variables evaluates under $x$ to the value of $c$ under the assignment that sends each index $i<m$ to the value of $x$ at the corresponding index in the larger input space.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit tree on $m$ variables
An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables
